purpose: Three integrated ghost-mask shields extending the existing left shoulder/arm motif downward, based on the user's schematic.

records.label: A 门阙方盾
records.prompt:
Create ONE full-body design variant of the exact blue Chinese ghost-armored MALE GUARD in IMAGE1, implementing the user's shield paintover concept in IMAGE2.
Image2 is a ROUGH SCHEMATIC of the LEFT-SIDE ghost-mask assembly extending DOWNWARD into a coherent giant shield. The colored arrows only indicate shape flow, not decorations to reproduce. Output NO arrows, annotations or sketch artifacts.

CORE DESIGN REQUIREMENT:
Transform the EXISTING HUGE GHOST MASK ON SCREEN LEFT into the TOP OF ONE INTEGRATED VERTICAL ARM-SHIELD. Continue its design naturally DOWN past the current forearm/fist area toward the calf/ankle into a substantial designed shield body. The upper ghost face and lower shield must look like ONE crafted object. Do NOT leave a detached mask shoulder above an unrelated rectangle. Do NOT add a separate shield to screen-right or a second shield.
The old screen-left forearm/gauntlet is now behind/inside this new protective shield assembly; remove its old isolated fist silhouette if it collides with the shield face. Show a plausible braced elbow/strap/handle connection along the inner edge near the torso, with no extra fingers/arms. Both legs/boots should still read, shield may overlap part of the near leg but not hide both feet. The other arm at SCREEN RIGHT stays naturally empty and relaxed.
The ghost-mask SHIELD DESIGN itself is LEFT-RIGHT SYMMETRICAL about its local vertical centerline, allowing modest perspective in the illustration. Keep the familiar blue guardian face with two cyan eye slits and simple fang/jaw shapes at the upper section, plus its one tall backward-curving crest. Simplify small facial details rather than multiplying teeth/horns. Extend the mask brow/jaw/silver edges into functional shield ribs and rim. The lower body is real protective mass with visible thickness and broad dark-blue planes.

LOCK THE CHARACTER:
Same mature human face, all-dark simplified beard with NO white beard patch, dark hairstyle/topknot, broad powerful compact body, current unarmed grounded pose, blue/navy/steel palette, small cyan ghost curls, simplified armor and warm ivory background. No sword, spear, extra shield, recoloring, new costume, face replacement or added jewelry. Preserve the large graphic silhouette and readable face.
Project GEM ICON finish: confident dark contour, clean substantial blue/silver planes, 2–3 main values per material, no tiny facet mosaic, thin engraving, dense straps, studs, glyphs, metal scratches or glossy 3D effects. Shield density concentrated at the existing upper mask, lower two-thirds kept calm and bold.
ONE full-body guard only on square plain warm ivory, entire highest crest, lowest shield edge and both boots safely in frame. No title, text, diagram, ground shadow, extra people or cropped body. 
VARIANT A — 门阙方盾 / SPIRIT GATE.
Extend the ghost mask's silver cheek frame and lower jaw into TWO thick near-parallel vertical steel rails. These surround one broad cobalt/navy shield body continuing all the way down toward upper ankle. Strong gate-like almost rectangular silhouette, subtle stepped wide shoulders under the ghost face and matching clipped bottom corners. Bottom is a broad stable horizontal edge, not a pointed spear.
The mask occupies the upper quarter of the complete shield; the dark open mouth smoothly transitions into a central dark vertical recess/ridge rather than ending as a separate jaw sitting on a box. Carry a single shallow inverted-U/cloud-arch crossbar from the mouth into the upper shield-body boundary. Lower face has just two broad blue value planes and a plain narrow steel toe cap. No lower emblem. Use one or two gentle inward stepped transitions in outer rails to avoid a boring rectangle, both sides mirrored.
Heavy physical thickness, clear protective door-panel mass, elegant Chinese gate architecture logic. Shield front is calm and visually unified with the upper mask.

VARIANT C — 叠甲重盾 / THREE-PLATE BULWARK.
Extend the ghost mask's strong jaw into THREE LARGE overlapping protective shield plates, joined into ONE solid broad elongated octagonal shield. The plates become successively a little narrower downward, with mirrored clipped corners and one blunt broad lower edge. Each plate is a substantial blue mass with a single thick silver leading edge echoing the jaw curve. Three plates TOTAL, not rows of scales, fingers, narrow strips or many small segments.
The first plate grows directly from below the ghost mouth/cheeks, the second broad middle plate covers the old forearm/fist region, and the third lower plate reaches toward calf/upper ankle. Overlap creates a few clear horizontal step shadows and strong depth. Outer silhouette is broad and armored, slightly stepped inward on each side, locally left-right symmetric. No separate mask shoulder plus free-floating shield.
Front center quiet cobalt/navy with one shallow continuous vertical ridge connecting all three plates; few broad planes, no emblems or engravings. The silhouette should feel like a massive Chinese spirit guardian's layered breastplate extended into an arm-shield, thicker and more compact than a pointed kite and more articulated than a plain door slab. Keep complete shield lower edge and both boots visible.
